steps.name: Install Python 3.12 (newest supported), the package and pinned test tools
argv: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git nodejs python3-venv && python3 -m venv /tmp/uv-bootstrap && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/pip install --quiet uv==0.10.2 && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv venv --python 3.12.12 .venv && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv pip install --python .venv '.[dev]' pytest==9.1.1 ruff==0.16.10

steps.name: Check out pinned Hermes and install its locked runtime
argv: git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git .hermes-runtime && git -C .hermes-runtime checkout --detach 2bd378ed1b8d6bf2192cb26e0a55ff3091e6bd19 && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv sync --frozen --python 3.14 --directory .hermes-runtime && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv pip install --python .hermes-runtime/.venv/bin/python pytest==9.1.1

steps.name: Lint the whole repo (same command as GitHub CI)
Build the wheel once and record its digest
Run Hermes plugin tests and fail on skips
argv: test_log=$(mktemp); env -u HERMES_HOME HOME="$PWD/.ci-hermes-home" AG4TE_HERMES_SOURCE="$PWD/.hermes-runtime" .hermes-runtime/.venv/bin/python -m pytest plugins/ag4te-hermes/tests -q --tb=short -rs 2>&1 | tee "$test_log"; if grep -Eq '[0-9]+ skipped' "$test_log"; then echo 'plugin tests were skipped'; exit 1; fi

steps.name: Smoke-test the built wheel from a clean venv (package data + demo)
argv: (cd .ci-results/dist && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); python3 -c 'import sys, zipfile; names = zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]).namelist(); assert any(n.startswith("archaeology/visualization/") and n.endswith(".html") for n in names), "wheel lacks visualization templates"' .ci-results/dist/*.whl; accept=$(mktemp -d); /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv venv --python 3.12.12 "$accept/venv"; /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv pip install --python "$accept/venv" .ci-results/dist/*.whl; cd "$accept"; ./venv/bin/devarch --help > /dev/null; ./venv/bin/devarch demo --force --build-db; test -s projects/demo-archaeology/data/archaeology.db
